title: Higher limits and BROWSE support for Unity Catalog secrets
body: A schema can now hold up to 1,000 Unity Catalog secrets, and a metastore up to 10,000, up from 100 and 1,000. The limits apply to Databricks-managed secrets and secrets backed by AWS Secrets Manager. `BROWSE` on a catalog now applies to Unity Catalog secrets, so users can discover secrets and their metadata without being able to read the values or reference the secrets in code. See [Privileges for Unity Catalog secrets](/aws/en/security/secrets/unity-catalog-secrets#privileges-for-uc-secrets).
